competitors.name: Pfizer Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: Similar revenue ($63.6B in 2024) and R&D focus in oncology, immunology, and vaccines. Strong commercial execution with 7% operational revenue growth in non-COVID products[2].

competitors.name: Merck & Co., Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: Comparable revenue ($64.2B in 2024) and focus on innovative therapies. Grew pharmaceutical sales by 10% (ex-FX) in 2024, with strong R&D pipeline progress[3][4].

competitors.name: Novartis AG
competitors.relevance_justification: Global pharma leader with focus on oncology and immunology. Revenue model combines high-margin pharmaceuticals and generics, aligning with AstraZeneca's diversified approach[5].

competitors.name: Roche Holding AG
competitors.relevance_justification: Leader in oncology and diagnostics with integrated healthcare solutions. Strategic acquisitions (e.g., Foundation Medicine) mirror AstraZeneca's innovation focus[6][18].

competitors.name: Bristol Myers Squibb Co.
competitors.relevance_justification: Growth portfolio revenue of $22.6B (2024) in oncology/immunology. Strong R&D pipeline with recent FDA approvals like Cobenfy[9][10].

competitors.name: AbbVie Inc.
competitors.relevance_justification: High gross margins (81.1% in 2024) and focus on immunology/oncology. $56.3B revenue with strategic pipeline diversification post-Humira[11][12].

competitors.name: GlaxoSmithKline PLC
competitors.relevance_justification: Diversified portfolio in vaccines and specialty medicines. Achieved 12% CER sales growth in 2023 (ex-COVID), emphasizing R&D for long-term growth[13][14].

competitors.name: Sanofi
competitors.relevance_justification: Hybrid model of branded pharmaceuticals and generics. Focus on diabetes, cardiovascular, and vaccine segments aligns with AstraZeneca's therapeutic areas[7].

competitors.name: Eli Lilly and Co.
competitors.relevance_justification: High-growth diabetes/oncology portfolio with $3.347B from Imbruvica. Emphasis on precision medicine and R&D-driven pipeline[8].
